meta.name: boost-prompt
meta.description: Interactive prompt refinement workflow: interrogates scope, deliverables, constraints; copies final markdown to clipboard; never writes code. Requires the Joyride extension.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过对话逐步完善提示词，自动复制到剪贴板
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常需要编写和打磨AI提示词。
copy.tagline_en: Refine prompts through interactive Q&A, copy to clipboard
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often craft and polish AI prompts.

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude会变成一位提示词优化助手。它会反复追问你的任务目标、交付物和限制条件，帮你把模糊的想法改写成结构清晰的Markdown格式任务提示，并自动复制到剪贴板。它不会写代码。
howto.when: 当你要求Claude帮你优化或改进一个提示词时触发。典型情况是你说“帮我优化这个提示”或“改进我的prompt”时。

say.text: 帮我优化这个提示：写一封给客户的邮件。
say.note: Claude会追问细节，改进prompt并复制到剪贴板。

say.text: 我有个模糊的需求，帮我整理成清晰的任务提示。
say.note: Claude会一步步提问，最终生成结构化Markdown。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude becomes a prompt optimization assistant. It iteratively asks about your task scope, deliverables, and constraints to refine vague ideas into a clear markdown task prompt, then copies it to clipboard. It never writes code.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to help refine or improve a prompt. Typical scenarios: saying "Help me optimize this prompt" or "Improve my prompt".

say_en.text: Help me optimize this prompt: write an email to a client.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for details, improve the prompt, and copy it.

say_en.text: I have a vague need, help me turn it into a clear task prompt.
say_en.note: Claude will step-by-step ask questions and output structured markdown.
